titleEn: The Glory of Kings — The Rods Laid Up: Aaron's Rod Blooms (ch. 98, part 1 of 2)
part: ch. 98, part 1 of 2 — The Rods Laid Up: Aaron's Rod Blooms
about: Moses has the twelve rods written with the tribes' names and laid up before God overnight, and Aaron's rod is found blossoming and fragrant (Numbers 17). The chronicler reads the rod as Mary and the ark, gold, wood, gomor, manna and tablets as figures of her and of Christ, then the rock Moses struck at Kadesh (Numbers 20) as Christ, with a chain of Gospel sayings.

sentences.t: ፺፰ ፡ በእንተ ፡ በትረ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ ወአሮን ።
sentences.l: 98. Concerning rod-of Moses and-Aaron
sentences.i: Chapter 98: Concerning the Rod of Moses and Aaron
sentences.n: Chapter heading. ፺፰ is the numeral 98 (90 + 8). በእንተ 'concerning' takes the construct state: በትረ is the construct of በትር 'rod'; ወአሮን 'and Aaron' (proclitic ወ- 'and').

sentences.t: ወነገሮሙ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ ዘንተ ፡ ወአምጽኡ ፡ በበአብያተ ፡ አበዊሆሙ ፡ እለ ፡ ኀረዩ ፡ ለንጽሕ ፡ ወኮነ ፡ ፲ ፡ ወ፪ ፡ አብትረ ፤
sentences.l: And-told-them Moses this, and-they-brought, by-houses-of fathers-their, those-who they-chose for-purity(?), and-were 10 and-2 rods;
sentences.i: And Moses told them this, and they brought, house by house of their fathers, those they had chosen as pure (?); and there were twelve rods.
sentences.n: ወነገሮሙ is ወ- 'and' + ነገረ 'told' (3ms perfect) + -ሙ 'them'; ወአምጽኡ 'and they brought' (አምጽአ, causative stem, 3mp). በበ- is distributive ('house by house'), አብያተ is the plural construct of ቤት. እለ ኀረዩ 'those who chose', i.e. 'whom they chose' (ኀረየ); ለንጽሕ 'for purity' or 'as pure' is uncertain (?). ወኮነ ፲ ፡ ወ፪ 'and there were 10 and 2': Ethiopic numerals, ፲ = 10, ፪ = 2, with ወ 'and' between them; አብትረ is the plural of በትር 'rod'. See Numbers 17:2.

sentences.t: ወጸሐፈ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ አብትሪሆሙ ፡ በአስማተ ፡ አበዊሆሙ ፤
sentences.l: And-wrote Moses rods-their with-names-of fathers-their;
sentences.i: And Moses wrote their rods with the names of their fathers.
sentences.n: ወጸሐፈ 'and he wrote' (ጸሐፈ, 3ms perfect). አብትሪሆሙ 'their rods' (plural አብትር + -ሆሙ 'their'). በአስማተ 'with the names of': በ- 'with, in' + plural construct of ስም 'name'; አበዊሆሙ 'their fathers' (plural of አብ with suffix).

sentences.t: በትረ ፡ አሮን ፡ ተጽሕፈት ፡ በሌዊ ፡ ወበትረ ፡ ከርሚን ፡ ተጽሕፈ ፡ በይሁዳ ፡ ወበትረ ፡ አዶንያስ ፡ ተጽሕፈት ፡ በሮቤል ፡ ወኵሉ ፡ ቤተ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ከማሁ ፡ ተጽሕፉ ፡ አብትሪሆሙ ፡ በበአስማተ ፡ አበዊሆሙ ።
sentences.l: Rod-of Aaron was-written for-Levi, and-rod-of Karmin was-written for-Judah, and-rod-of Adonyas was-written for-Reuben; and-all house-of Israel likewise were-written rods-their each-by-names-of fathers-their.
sentences.i: The rod of Aaron was written for Levi, the rod of Karmin (?) for Judah, and the rod of Adonyas (?) for Reuben; and likewise all the house of Israel had their rods written, each by the names of their fathers.
sentences.n: ተጽሕፈት 'was written' (ተጽሕፈ, the ተ- passive of ጸሐፈ; ተጽሕፈት is 3fs, agreeing with feminine በትር 'rod', while ተጽሕፈ is 3ms and ተጽሕፉ 3mp). በትረ is construct before the owner's name. በሌዊ 'on/for Levi' (በ- 'in, on'). The names ከርሚን and አዶንያስ are as printed and do not match the Hebrew tribal heads (?); I transliterate them. ከማሁ 'likewise'; በበአስማተ 'each by the names of' (distributive በበ-).

sentences.t: ወይቤሎ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ውግር ፡ ኀበ ፡ ጽዮን ፡ ኀበ ፡ ደብተራ ፡ ዘመርጡል ፡ ወዕጸው ፡ ህየ ፡ እስከ ፡ ነግህ ፡ ወንሥኦን ፡ በቅድሜሆሙ ፡ ወሀቦሙ ፡ ለለ ፡ በትሮሙ ፡ ለለ ፡ አብያተ ፡ አበዊሆሙ ፡ ለለ ፡ አስማቲሆሙ ፡ ዘጽሑፍ ፡ ውስተ ፡ በትሩ ፡ ወዘተረክበ ፡ ትእምርት ፡ በውስተ ፡ በትሩ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ኀረይኩ ፡ ይኩነኒ ፡ ካህነ ።
sentences.l: And-said-to-him God: Place(?) toward Zion, toward tent of-mərṭul(?), and-shut there until dawn, and-take-them before-them, and-give-them, to-each rod-their, to-each houses-of fathers-their, to-each names-their, that-written in rod-his, and-that-was-found sign in-rod-his, he I-chose, may-be-to-me priest.
sentences.i: And the Lord said to him: Lay them toward Zion, to the tent of Mertul (?), and shut them in there until dawn; then take them before the people and give them out, to each one his rod, to each of the houses of their fathers, to each their names, that which is written on his rod. And the man in whose rod a sign is found, he is the one I have chosen to be my priest.
sentences.n: ወይቤሎ 'and he said to him' (ይቤ + -ሎ 'to him'). Imperatives: ውግር 'lay, cast' (?), ወዕጸው 'and shut in', ወንሥኦን 'and take them' (ንሣእ + -ን 'them'), ወሀቦሙ 'and give them'. ኀበ 'toward, to'. ዘመርጡል: ዘ is the relative 'of, which', but መርጡል is not a word I can read and may be a corrupt or foreign name (?); I leave it as 'Mertul'. ለለ is distributive 'to each'. ዘጽሑፍ 'that which is written' (passive participle of ጸሐፈ). ወዘተረክበ 'and he in whose [rod] was found' (ተረክበ, passive of ረከበ). ይኩነኒ ካህነ 'may he be to me a priest' (ይኩን 'let be' + -ኒ 'to me'; ካህነ accusative). Compare Numbers 17:5.

sentences.t: ወነገሮሙ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ ዘንተ ፡ ነገረ ፡ ወገብሩ ፡ በከመ ፡ አዘዞሙ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ።
sentences.l: And-told-them Moses this word, and-they-did as commanded-them God.
sentences.i: Moses told them this word, and they did as the Lord had commanded them.
sentences.n: ወነገሮሙ 'and he told them'; ወገብሩ 'and they did' (ገብረ, 3mp); በከመ 'as, according as'; አዘዞሙ 'he commanded them' (አዘዘ, causative stem, + -ሙ). Numbers 17:6.

sentences.t: ወእምዝ ፡ ሶበ ፡ ጸብሐ ፡ ነሥአ ፡ ወመጽኡ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ አእሩገ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ወአሮን ፤
sentences.l: And-then, when dawned, he-took, and-came all elders-of Israel and-Aaron;
sentences.i: And then, when morning came, he took them, and all the elders of Israel and Aaron came.
sentences.n: ወእምዝ 'and after this'; ሶበ 'when'; ጸብሐ 'it dawned' (3ms perfect of ጸብሐ); ነሥአ 'he took' (Moses, with 'them', the rods, understood). አእሩገ is the plural construct of 'elder' (an irregular broken plural, here before እስራኤል).

sentences.t: ወቦአ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ በቅድሜሆሙ ፡ ወአልዐሎን ፡ ለአብትር ፡ ወአምጽኦን ፡ ቅድመ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ሕዝብ ፡ ወተረክበት ፡ በትረ ፡ አሮን ፡ ምስለ ፡ ፍሬ ፡ ወጽጌ ፡ ከርካዕ ፡ እንተ ፡ ትምዕዝ ፡ ሠናየ ፡ መዐዛ ፤
sentences.l: And-entered Moses before-them, and-lifted-them the rods, and-brought-them before all people; and-was-found rod-of Aaron with fruit and-blossom-of almond(?) which gives-off good scent;
sentences.i: Moses went in before them, lifted up the rods, and brought them out before all the people; and the rod of Aaron was found with fruit and almond (?) blossom, which gave off a sweet scent.
sentences.n: ወቦአ 'and he entered'; ወአልዐሎን 'and he lifted them' (አልዐለ, causative stem, + -ን 'them', feminine or plural object); ወአምጽኦን 'and he brought them'. ቅድመ 'before' (+ construct). ተረክበት 'was found' (3fs passive, agreeing with በትር). ከርካዕ I read as 'almond' from the context of Numbers 17:8 (?). እንተ ትምዕዝ: እንተ is the feminine relative 'which', ትምዕዝ 'gives off a scent' (3fs imperfect) (?); ሠናየ መዐዛ 'a good scent'.

sentences.t: ወይቤሎሙ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ ርእዩኬ ፡ ዛቲ ፡ በትር ፡ ዘኀረየ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ አምላክክሙ ፡ ኪያሁ ፡ ፍርሁ ፡ ወተቀነዩ ፡ ሎቱ ፤
sentences.l: And-said-to-them Moses: See-then this rod which chose God, God-your; him fear, and-serve to-him;
sentences.i: And Moses said to them: See, then, this rod that the Lord your God has chosen. Fear him, and serve him.
sentences.n: ወይቤሎሙ 'and he said to them'. ርእዩኬ 'see then' (imperative 2mp of ርእየ + the particle -ኬ 'then, indeed'). ዘኀረየ 'which he chose' (relative ዘ + ኀረየ). አምላክክሙ 'your God' (አምላክ + -ክሙ 'your', 2mp). ኪያሁ 'him', a fronted object pronoun that stresses it; ፍርሁ 'fear' (imperative 2mp). ወተቀነዩ ሎቱ 'and serve him' (ተቀነየ takes ለ-: ሎቱ 'to him').

sentences.t: ወሰገዲ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ሕዝብ ፡ ለእግዚኣብሔር ።
sentences.l: And-bowed-down all people to-God.
sentences.i: And all the people bowed down to the Lord.
sentences.n: ወሰገዲ is printed with final -ዲ where a 3mp perfect would be ሰገዱ; I take it as 'they bowed' (ሰገደ) with the collective subject ኵሉ ሕዝብ (?). ለእግዚኣብሔር 'to God' (ለ- 'to, for').

sentences.t: በትርኬ ፡ ይእቲ ፡ ማርያም ፡ ወዘእንበለ ፡ ትስተይ ፡ ማየ ፡ ዘሠረጸት ፡ ጽጌ ፡ ዘእንበለ ፡ ዘርአ ፡ ብእሲ ፡ ዘተወልደ ፡ እምኔሃ ፡ ቃለ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፤
sentences.l: Rod-then it Mary, and-without she-drink water who budded blossom, without seed-of man, who was-born from-her Word-of God;
sentences.i: The rod, then, is Mary, who without drinking water put forth a blossom, without the seed of a man; from her was born the Word of God.
sentences.n: Here the rod becomes a figure of Mary (compare Isaiah 11:1). በትርኬ 'the rod, then' (-ኬ); ይእቲ 'she, it is' (feminine, so 'she is Mary'). ዘእንበለ 'without' takes a subjunctive (ትስተይ 'she drinks') or a construct (ዘርአ ብእሲ 'seed of a man'). ዘሠረጸት 'who sprouted' (ሠረጸ, 3fs). ዘተወልደ 'who was born' (ተወልደ, passive of ወለደ) has ቃለ እግዚኣብሔር 'the Word of God' as its subject, with እምኔሃ 'from her' (እም- + -ሃ).

sentences.t: ወዘይቤ ፡ ኀረይኩ ፡ ኣርኢ ፡ ትእምርተ ፡ ወይኩነኒ ፡ ካህነ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ኀረያ ፡ ለማርያም ፡ እምኵሉ ፡ ተዓይነ ፡ እስራኤል ፤
sentences.l: And-what he-said: I-chose; I-show sign, and-may-be-to-me priest, it-is God chose-her Mary from-all tribes-of Israel;
sentences.i: And what he said, 'I have chosen; I will show a sign, and he shall be my priest', means that the Lord chose Mary from among all the tribes of Israel;
sentences.n: ወዘይቤ 'and what he said' (ዘ 'that which' + ይቤ). ኀረይኩ 'I chose' (1cs perfect); ኣርኢ 'I will show' (a cohortative of አርአየ); ትእምርተ 'a sign' (accusative -ተ). ውእቱ 'it is [this]', explaining the figure. ኀረያ 'he chose her' (-ያ 'her'). ተዓይነ 'tribes of' (construct plural of ተዓይን; 'camps, tribes' (?)).

sentences.t: በከመ ፡ ተነበየ ፡ ዳዊት ፡ አቡሃ ፡ ያበድሮን ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ለአናቅጸ ፡ ጽዮን ፡ እምኵሉ ፡ ተዓይኒሁ ፡ ለያዕቆብ ፤
sentences.l: as prophesied David father-her: He-prefers(?) God the-gates-of Zion above-all dwellings-his for-Jacob;
sentences.i: as David her father prophesied: 'The Lord prefers the gates of Zion to all the dwellings of Jacob.'
sentences.n: Psalm 87:2 (LXX 86:2). ተነበየ 'he prophesied'; ዳዊት አቡሃ 'David her father', that is her forefather. ያበድሮን 'he prefers them' (?) (አበደረ, with -ሆን 'them'): the verb is uncertain (?). ለአናቅጸ ጽዮን 'the gates of Zion' (አናቅጽ plural, construct); እምኵሉ 'more than all'; ተዓይኒሁ ለያዕቆብ 'the dwellings of Jacob' (a possessive with ለ-, 'his ... of Jacob') (?).

sentences.t: ወመትልው ፡ ይቤ ፡ ነኪር ፡ ነገሩ ፡ በእንቲአኪ ፡ ህገረ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፤
sentences.l: And-follower he-said: Wondrous were-spoken concerning-you, city-of God;
sentences.i: And the next (verse) says: 'Glorious things are spoken of you, city of God.'
sentences.n: Psalm 87:3. መትልው 'follower, next' (?), here probably 'the following saying' (?). ነኪር ነገሩ: ነኪር 'wondrous, strange', ነገሩ 'they spoke', used impersonally as 'things are said'. በእንቲአኪ 'concerning you' (f.); ህገረ 'city of' (construct, ሀገር).

sentences.t: እምኵሉ ፡ ትዕይንተ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ወአናቅጺሃ ፡ ሶበ ፡ ይብል ፡ አርምሞ ፡ አፉሃ ፡ ወንጽሐ ፡ ከናፍሪሃ ፡ ወስብሐት ፡ ዘይወፅእ ፡ እምአፉሃ ፡ ከመ ፡ ጸቃውዕ ፡ ዘይውሕዝ ፡ እምከናፍሪሃ ፡ ወንጽሐ ፡ ድንግልናሃ ፡ ዘእንበለ ፡ ጥልቀት ፡ ወዘእንበለ ፡ ሙስና ፡ ወርኵስ ፡ እምቅድመ ፡ ትለድኒ ፤
sentences.l: From-all hosts-of Israel and-gates-her, when he-says: silence mouth-her, and-purity lips-her, and-praise which goes-out from-mouth-her like balm(?) which flows from-lips-her, and-purity virginity-her, without blemish(?) and-without corruption and-uncleanness, from-before she-bears;
sentences.i: From all the hosts of Israel and its gates, when he says: the silence of her mouth, and the purity of her lips, and the praise that goes out from her mouth like balm (?) flowing from her lips, and the purity of her virginity, without blemish (?), without corruption or uncleanness, even before she bore;
sentences.n: A hard sentence, rendered as it stands; the grammar joining ሶበ ይብል 'when he says' to the list that follows is uncertain (?). ትዕይንተ 'hosts of' (construct). Suffix -ሃ 'her' on አፉሃ 'her mouth', ከናፍሪሃ 'her lips', ድንግልናሃ 'her virginity'; ንጽሐ 'purity of' is a construct. ዘይወፅእ 'which goes out', ዘይውሕዝ 'which flows' (ዘ + imperfect). ጸቃውዕ 'balm' is a guess from the context (?). ጥልቀት 'blemish' (?). ዘእንበለ 'without'. እምቅድመ ትለድኒ 'before she bears' (ትለድ 'she bears' + -ኒ, the emphatic particle).

sentences.t: ወእምድኅረ ፡ ወለደትኒ ፡ ንጽሕትኒ ፡ ወቅድስትኒ ፡ ወከማሁ ፡ ከመኒ ፡ እስከ ፡ ለዓለም ፤
sentences.l: And-after she-bore-also, pure-also and-holy-also, and-thus likewise for ever;
sentences.i: And even after she bore, she is still pure and still holy, and so she is for ever;
sentences.n: The particle -ኒ 'also, even' is attached to each word: ወለደትኒ 'she bore, even', ንጽሕትኒ 'pure (f.), still', ወቅድስትኒ 'and holy (f.), still'. ከማሁ ከመኒ 'thus likewise'; እስከ ለዓለም 'for ever'.

sentences.t: ወበሰማያትኒ ፡ ንጽሕት ፡ ምስለ ፡ መላእክት ፡ ታንሶሱ ፡ ወይእቲ ፡ በትረ ፡ አሮን ፡ ህሉት ፡ ይእቲ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ጽዮን ፡ ምስለ ፡ ጎሞር ፡ መና ፡ ምልእት ፡ ወምስለ ፡ ክልኤ ፡ ጽላት ፡ እለ ፡ ተጽሕፋ ፡ በአጽባዕተ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ወጽዮን ፡ ሰማያዊት ፡ መንፈሳዊት ፡ መልዕልቴሆሙ ፡ ጽዮን ፡ እንተ ፡ ግብራ ፡ ወኅብራ ፡ ነኪር ፡ እንተ ፡ ለሊሁ ፡ ገባሪሃ ፡ ወኬንያሃ ፡ ለማኅደረ ፡ ስብሐቲሁ ፨
sentences.l: And-in-heavens-too pure with angels she-walks-about; and-she rod-of Aaron present it in Zion, with gomor-of manna full, and-with two tablets which were-written by-fingers-of God; and-Zion heavenly spiritual above-them, Zion whose making and-form wondrous, whose maker himself, and-builder(?)-her, as-dwelling-of glory-his ፨
sentences.i: In the heavens too she is pure, and moves about with the angels. And that rod of Aaron is present in Zion, with a gomor full of manna and with the two tablets that were written by the fingers of God. And heavenly, spiritual Zion is above them: Zion, whose making and form are wondrous, whose maker is he himself, and whose builder (?) is for the dwelling of his glory.
sentences.n: ታንሶሱ 'she walks about' (3fs, a root with a repeated final consonant). ህሉት ይእቲ 'she is present' (ህሉት is a participle). ጎሞር መና ምልእት 'a gomor of manna, full' (Exodus 16:33; the gomor and the rod are laid up in the ark, Hebrews 9:4); ክልኤ ጽላት 'two tablets'; በአጽባዕተ 'by the fingers of' (Exodus 31:18). ጽዮን ሰማያዊት 'Zion, heavenly' (adjective after its noun). Zion is both the ark and the heavenly dwelling. መልዕልቴሆሙ 'above them'. እንተ ግብራ ወኅብራ ነኪር 'whose making and form are wondrous' (እንተ is a feminine relative, with -ራ 'her' on each noun). ለሊሁ 'he himself'; ኬንያሃ 'her builder' (?). ለማኅደረ 'as the dwelling of' (ለ- with a construct). The unit ends at the section mark ፨.

sentences.t: ወይቤሎ ፡ ለሙሴ ፡ ግበር ፡ ታቦተ ፡ እምዕፅ ፡ ዘኢይነቅዝ ፡ ወትለብጦ ፡ በወርቅ ፡ ጽሩይ ፡ እንተ ፡ ኵለንታሁ ፤
sentences.l: And-said-to Moses: Make ark from-wood which not-decays, and-overlay-it with-gold pure which all-of-it;
sentences.i: And he said to Moses: Make an ark of wood that does not decay, and overlay it with pure gold, all of it.
sentences.n: ግበር 'make' (imperative of ገብረ); ታቦተ 'ark' (accusative -ተ; ታቦት, the ark of the covenant, is central to the book). ዘኢይነቅዝ 'which does not rot' (ዘ + ኢ- negative + imperfect). ወትለብጦ 'and you shall overlay it' (ለብጠ + -ሁ 'it' shortened to -ጦ). ጽሩይ 'pure'. እንተ ኵለንታሁ 'all of it' (ኵለንታ 'wholeness' + -ሁ); Exodus 25:10-11.

sentences.t: ወርቅሰ ፡ ጽርየተ ፡ መለኮት ፡ ዘወረደ ፡ እምሰማያት ፡ እስመ ፡ መለኮት ፡ ይእኅዝ ፡ ኵሎ ፡ ሰማያተ ፡ ወምድረ ፡ ወከማሁ ፡ በወርቅ ፡ ተለብጠት ፡ ታቦት ፡ ማኅደራ ፡ ለጽዮን ፡ ሰማያዊት ፡ ወታቦት ፡ ትተረጐም ፡ ማርያም ፡ ወዕፅ ፡ ዘኢይነቅዝ ፡ ይተረጐም ፡ ክርስቶስ ፡ መድኀኒነ ፡ ወጎሞር ፡ እንተ ፡ ይእቲ ፡ መሶበ ፡ ወርቅ ፡ እንተ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ታቦት ፡ ትተረጐም ፡ ይእቲ ፡ ማርያም ፡ ወመና ፡ ዘውስተ ፡ መሶብ ፡ ሥጋሁ ፡ ለክርስቶስ ፡ ይተረጐም ፡ ዘወረደ ፡ እምሰማያት ፡ ወቃለ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ዘተጽሕፈ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ክልኤ ፡ ጽላት ፡ ይተረጐም ፡ ክርስቶስ ፡ ወልደ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ወጽዮን ፡ መንፈሳዊት ፡ ትተረጐም ፡ ብርሃነ ፡ መለኮት ፤
sentences.l: And-gold-indeed purity-of Godhead which came-down from-heavens, for Godhead holds all heavens and-earth; and-likewise with-gold was-overlaid ark, dwelling-her of-Zion heavenly; and-ark is-interpreted Mary, and-wood which not-decays is-interpreted Christ savior-our; and-gomor which it basket-of gold which in ark is-interpreted she Mary, and-manna which in basket flesh-his of-Christ is-interpreted, who came-down from-heavens; and-word-of God which was-written in two tablets is-interpreted Christ, son-of God; and-Zion spiritual is-interpreted light-of Godhead;
sentences.i: As for the gold, it is the purity of the Godhead that came down from the heavens, for the Godhead holds all the heavens and the earth. And so the ark was overlaid with gold, as the dwelling of heavenly Zion. The ark is read as Mary, and the wood that does not decay is read as Christ our Savior. The gomor, which is the golden basket within the ark, is read as Mary; and the manna in the basket is read as the flesh of Christ, who came down from the heavens. The word of God written on the two tablets is read as Christ, the Son of God; and spiritual Zion is read as the light of the Godhead;
sentences.n: The interpretation begins; it runs without a ፤ for 60 words and is left whole. ወርቅሰ 'and gold, indeed' (-ሰ marks the topic). መለኮት 'Godhead, divinity'; ጽርየተ 'purity of' (construct). ይእኅዝ 'holds' (3ms imperfect, ኣኀዘ). ተለብጠት 'was overlaid' (3fs passive). ማኅደራ ለጽዮን 'the dwelling of Zion' (a noun with -ራ 'her' and ለ- marking the owner, a common way to express 'of'). ትተረጐም 'is interpreted' (3fs) and ይተረጐም (3ms): the ተ- passive of ተርጐመ 'interpret, translate'; the subject is the thing read, the meaning follows without a preposition. መሶበ ወርቅ 'a basket of gold' (construct). ሥጋሁ ለክርስቶስ 'the flesh of Christ'. ወልደ 'son of' (construct). ዘወረደ 'who came down' (John 6:51).

sentences.t: መንፈሳዊት ፡ ባሕርይ ፡ እንተ ፡ ተገምረት ፡ ውስተ ፡ ታቦት ፡ በከመ ፡ ዕንቈ ፡ ባሕርይ ፡ እንተ ፡ ተኀቱ ፡ ዘብዙኅ ፡ ሤጣ ፡ ወይእኅዛ ፡ ዘአጥረያ ፡ ውስተ ፡ እዴሁ ፡ ወይፀብጣ ፡ ወያገምራ ፡ ውስተ ፡ እዴሁ ፡ ወእንዘ ፡ ሀለወት ፡ ውስተ ፡ እዴሁ ፡ ቦአ ፡ ወተገምረ ፡ ውስቴታ ፤
sentences.l: Spiritual pearl which was-enclosed in ark, like pearl which was-sought-out(?) of-great price, and-holds-it he-who-acquired-it(?) in hand-his, and-weighs-it(?) and-wraps-it in hand-his, and-while she-was in hand-his he-entered and-was-enclosed within-her;
sentences.i: A spiritual pearl, enclosed in the ark, like a pearl of great price that was sought out (?); and the one who acquired it (?) holds it in his hand, weighs it (?), and wraps it up in his hand; and while it was in his hand, he entered and was enclosed within it;
sentences.n: Matthew 13:45-46 (the pearl of great price). ባሕርይ alone, and ዕንቈ ባሕርይ 'stone of the sea', is 'pearl' here (it also means 'nature'). ተገምረት 'was enclosed' (feminine; ተገምረ 'he was enclosed'). ተኀቱ 'was sought out' is uncertain (?). ዘብዙኅ ሤጣ 'of great price' (ዘ + 'much' + 'its price'). ዘአጥረያ 'he who acquired it' (?): a relative with a verb and -ያ 'it' (f.), root uncertain (?). ይፀብጣ 'weighs it' (?), ያገምራ 'wraps it' (ገምረ, causative). እንዘ ሀለወት 'while she was' (እንዘ + a perfect gives a circumstantial clause). The pearl is Mary, its owner Christ.

sentences.t: ወባሕርይ ፡ ዘአጥረያ ፡ ይተረጐም ፡ ቃለ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ክርስቶስ ፡ ወእንተ ፡ ተእኅዘት ፡ ባሕርይ ፡ መንፈሳዊት ፡ ትተረጐም ፡ ማርያም ፡ ወላዲተ ፡ ብርሃን ፡ ዘእምኔሃ ፡ ተሠገወ ፡ አክራጦስ ፡ ዘአልቦቱ ፡ ቱስሕት ፤
sentences.l: And-pearl which acquired-it(?) is-interpreted Word-of God Christ; and-which was-held pearl spiritual is-interpreted Mary, mother-of light, from-whom became-flesh Akratos(?) who not-has-him fault(?);
sentences.i: The one who acquired the pearl (?) is read as the Word of God, Christ; and the spiritual pearl that was held is read as Mary, mother of light, from whom became flesh Akrātos (?), who has no fault (?);
sentences.n: Here the figure of the pearl is interpreted. ወላዲተ ብርሃን 'mother of light' (lit. 'bearer of'; construct). ዘእምኔሃ ተሠገወ 'from whom became flesh' (ተሠገወ, the usual verb for the incarnation). አክራጦስ looks like a Greek name or title (perhaps 'unmixed') (?). ዘአልቦቱ 'who has not' (አልቦ 'there is not' + -ቱ 'to him'); ቱስሕት 'fault, error' (?).

sentences.t: በውስቴታ ፡ ገብረ ፡ ማኅፈደ ፡ ለርእሱ ፡ እምሥጋሃ ፡ ንጹሕ ፡ ወተወልደ ፡ እምኔሃ ፡ ብርሃን ፡ ዘእምብርሃን ፡ አምላክ ፡ ዘእምአምላክ ፡ ዘተወልደ ፡ በፈቃዲ ፡ ወኢተገብረ ፡ በእደ ፡ ካልእ ፡ አላ ፡ ለርእሱ ፡ ገብረ ፡ ማኅፈደ ፡ በእንተ ፡ ኢትትረከብ ፡ ጥበብ ፡ እንተ ፡ ዕዲት ፡ እምኅሊና ፡ ሰብእ ፨
sentences.l: In-her he-made palace(?) for-himself from-flesh-her pure, and-was-born from-her light from-light, God from-God, who was-born by-will-his, and-not-was-made by-hand-of another, but for-himself he-made palace(?), because not is-found wisdom which surpasses-from thought-of man ፨
sentences.i: In her he made himself a palace (?) from her pure flesh, and from her was born light from light, God from God, who was born of his own will and was not made by another's hand; but he made the palace for himself, because of a wisdom that cannot be found, which surpasses the thought of man.
sentences.n: ማኅፈድ 'palace, tower, citadel' (?) (a fortified house); here the womb is the palace. ለርእሱ 'for himself' (lit. 'for his head'). ብርሃን ዘእምብርሃን አምላክ ዘእምአምላክ 'light from light, God from God' echoes the Nicene Creed. ዘተወልደ 'who was born'; በፈቃዲ 'by his will'; ወኢተገብረ 'and was not made' (ኢ- negative). እደ ካልእ 'hand of another'. ኢትትረከብ 'is not found' (3fs passive), እንተ ዕዲት 'which surpasses' (ዕዲት, a feminine participle); ኅሊና ሰብእ 'the thought of man'.

sentences.t: ወካዕበ ፡ አመ ፡ አውፅኦሙ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ለእስራኤል ፡ እምግብጽ ፡ ጸምኡ ፡ ማየ ፡ በቃዴስ ፡ ወአንጐርጐሩ ፡ ወበከዩ ፡ ኀበ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ ወሖረ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ ኀበ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ወአይድዖ ፡ ዘንተ ፡ ለእግዚኣብሔር ፤
sentences.l: And-again when brought-out-them God Israel from-Egypt, they-thirsted water at-Kadesh and-murmured and-wept toward Moses; and-went Moses toward God, and-told-him this to-God;
sentences.i: And again: when God brought Israel out of Egypt, they thirsted for water at Kadesh, and murmured and wept to Moses; and Moses went to God and told him this.
sentences.n: Numbers 20:1-6. ወካዕበ 'and again'. አመ 'when' (lit. 'on the day that'), with the verbal noun አውፅኦሙ 'his bringing them out' (አውፅአ, causative stem). ጸምኡ 'they thirsted' (ጸምአ, 3mp); ወአንጐርጐሩ 'and they murmured'; ወበከዩ 'and they wept'. ኀበ 'toward, to'. ወአይድዖ 'and he made known to him' (አይድዐ + -ሁ 'him').

sentences.t: ወይቤሎ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ንሣእ ፡ በትረከ ፡ ወዝብጣ ፡ ለይእቲ ፡ እዝኅ ፡ ወዘበጣ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ ኑኃ ፡ ወግድማ ፡ በአርአያ ፡ ትእምርተ ፡ መስቀል ፡ ወውሕዘት ፡ ማየ ፡ ፲ወ፪ ፡ አፍላግ ፡ ወሰትዩ ፡ እምኔሃ ፡ ወረ ፡ ወዩ ፡ ሰብኦሙ ፡ ወእንስሳሆሙ ፡ ወሰቲዮሙ ፡ ተለወቶሙ ፡ ይእቲ ፡ ኰኵሕ ፡ ወኰኵሕሰ ፡ ይተረጐም ፡ በክርስቶስ ፡ ወአፍላግ ፡ ሐዋርያት ፡ ወዘሰትዩ ፡ ትምህርተ ፡ ሐዋርያት ፡ ወበትርኒ ፡ ዕፀ ፡ መስቀል ፤
sentences.l: And-said-to-him God: Take rod-your, and-strike it, that rock(?); and-struck Moses its-length and-its-breadth in-likeness-of sign-of cross, and-flowed water twelve rivers, and-drank from-it and-were-sated people-their and-cattle-their, and-after-drinking-them followed-them that rock; and-rock-indeed is-interpreted in-Christ, and-rivers apostles, and-what-they-drank teaching-of apostles, and-rod-too wood-of cross;
sentences.i: And the Lord said to him: Take your rod and strike that rock (?). And Moses struck it, along its length and its breadth, in the likeness of the sign of the cross; and water flowed in twelve rivers, and they drank from it, and their people and their cattle were sated; and after their drinking, that rock followed them. The rock is read as Christ, the rivers as the apostles, what they drank as the teaching of the apostles, and the rod too as the wood of the cross;
sentences.n: Numbers 20:7-11, with the tradition of the rock that followed (1 Corinthians 10:4). ንሣእ 'take' (imperative); ዝብጣ 'strike it' (imperative + -ጣ 'it'); እዝኅ is a word I cannot place and the sentence reads on without it (?). ኑኃ ወግድማ 'its length and its breadth' (? ግድም 'width, side'). በአርአያ 'in the likeness of' (construct). ወውሕዘት 'and it flowed' (3fs); ፲ወ፪ 'twelve' (10 and 2). ወሰትዩ 'and they drank'; ወረወዩ I read as 'and were sated' (ረወየ), printed as two words (?). ሰቲዮሙ 'their drinking' (verbal noun + -ሙ). ተለወቶሙ 'it followed them'. ይተረጐም 'is read' as above, here with በ-: በክርስቶስ 'in/of Christ' (?). ወበትርኒ 'and the rod too' (-ኒ); ዕፀ 'wood of' (construct).

sentences.t: ወኰኵሕሰ ፡ በከመ ፡ ይቤ ፡ በወንጌል ፡ ዘሣረረ ፡ ዲበ ፡ ኰኵሕ ፡ ኢይትሀወክ ፡ እምአጋንንት ፤
sentences.l: And-rock-indeed as he-said in-gospel: Who is-founded upon rock not is-shaken by demons;
sentences.i: And of the rock, as he said in the Gospel: 'Whoever is founded upon the rock will not be shaken by demons.'
sentences.n: ወኰኵሕሰ 'and as for the rock' (-ሰ). Compare Matthew 7:24-25 and Luke 6:48. ዘሣረረ 'who is rooted, founded' (ሣረረ); ዲበ 'upon'; ኢይትሀወክ 'will not be shaken' (negative of the ተ- passive, ተሀወከ); እምአጋንንት 'by demons' (እም- 'from, by').

sentences.t: ወካዕበ ፡ ይቤ ፡ አነ ፡ አንቀጽ ፤
sentences.l: And-again he-said: I door;
sentences.i: And again he said: 'I am the door.'
sentences.n: John 10:9. Geʿez has no verb 'to be' here: አነ አንቀጽ is 'I [am] door'. ወካዕበ 'and again'.

sentences.t: ወካዕበ ፡ ይቤ ፡ አነ ፡ ዴዴ ፤
sentences.l: And-again he-said: I Dede(?);
sentences.i: And again he said: 'I am Dede (?).'
sentences.n: I cannot read ዴዴ; it is perhaps a corrupt or rare word for one of Christ's 'I am' sayings (?). I leave it as printed.

sentences.t: ወርእዩሂ ፡ ዘከመ ፡ ከፈሎሙ ፡ ለአርዳኢሁ ፡ እንዘ ፡ ይብል ፡ ወለእለ ፡ እምድኅሬሆሙ ፡ ጳጳሳት ፡ ወማኅበረ ፡ ክርስቲያን ፤
sentences.l: And-see-then how he-apportioned-them to-disciples-his, saying, and-to-those who after-them, bishops and-assembly-of Christians;
sentences.i: And see how he shared these among his disciples, saying, and with those who came after them, the bishops and the assembly of Christians:
sentences.n: ርእዩሂ 'and see' (imperative 2mp + -ሂ). ዘከመ 'how'; ከፈሎሙ 'he apportioned [it] to them' (ከፈለ + -ሙ); ለአርዳኢሁ 'to his disciples'. እንዘ ይብል 'saying'. ወለእለ እምድኅሬሆሙ 'and to those after them'. ጳጳሳት 'bishops' (from the Greek 'papas'); ማኅበረ 'assembly of' (construct).

sentences.t: አንተ ፡ ኰኵሕ ፡ ይቤሎ ፡ ለጴጥሮስ ፡ ወላዕሌከ ፡ አሐንጾሙ ፡ ለሕዝበ ፡ ክርስቲያን ፤
sentences.l: You rock, he-said-to Peter, and-upon-you I-will-build-them the-people-of Christians;
sentences.i: 'You are the rock,' he said to Peter, 'and upon you I will build the Christian people.'
sentences.n: Matthew 16:18. አንተ ኰኵሕ 'you [are] rock'. ወላዕሌከ 'and upon you' (ላዕለ + -ከ). አሐንጾሙ 'I will build them' (1cs imperfect of አሐነጸ, with -ሙ); the object is marked with ለ-: ለሕዝበ ክርስቲያን 'the people of Christians' (construct).

sentences.t: ወዓዲ ፡ ይቤ ፡ አነ ፡ ኖላዌ ፡ አባግዕ ፡ ወሎቱኒ ፡ ይቤሎ ፡ ሥልሰ ፡ ረዐይኬ ፡ አባግዕየ ፤
sentences.l: And-again he-said: I shepherd-of sheep; and-to-him-also he-said third-time tend-then sheep-my;
sentences.i: And again he said: 'I am the shepherd of the sheep.' And to him also he said, a third time: 'Tend my sheep.'
sentences.n: John 10:11, and John 21:15-17. ኖላዌ 'shepherd of' (construct). ወሎቱኒ 'and to him also' (ሎቱ + -ኒ); ሥልሰ 'a third time'; ረዐይኬ 'tend then' (imperative of ረዐየ + -ኬ); አባግዕየ 'my sheep' (-የ 'my').

sentences.t: ወካዕበ ፡ ይቤ ፡ አነ ፡ ጒንደ ፡ ዐጸደ ፡ ወይን ፤
sentences.l: And-again he-said: I trunk-of vineyard;
sentences.i: And again he said: 'I am the stock of the vine.'
sentences.n: John 15:1, 5. ጒንደ 'trunk, stock of' and ዐጸደ ወይን 'vineyard' (lit. 'enclosure of wine'), a chain of constructs.

sentences.t: ወሎሙኒ ፡ ይቤሎሙ ፡ አንትሙ ፡ አዕጹቂሁ ፡ ወአሕሩጊሁ ።
sentences.l: And-to-them-also he-said-to-them: You branches-its and-shoots-its.
sentences.i: And to them also he said: 'You are its branches and its shoots.'
sentences.n: John 15:5. ወሎሙኒ 'and to them also'; ይቤሎሙ 'he said to them'. አዕጹቂሁ 'its branches' (plural + -ሁ 'its'); አሕሩጊሁ 'its shoots' (?).
